bio.text: Chuck Hufstetler, a Republican, was elected to the Georgia State Senate in 2012, represents the 52nd District, and has chaired the Senate Finance Committee since 2017.
Hufstetler served on the Floyd County Commission from 1999 through 2006.

He worked 14 years in corporate manufacturing and finance, then became an anesthesia provider after earning a Master of Medical Science in Anesthesiology at Emory; he also holds a B.S. from the University of Georgia.
